statement.zh: **人物**：王小云（Xiaoyun Wang）。本行是人物行，其原理对应贡献而非算法叙述。论文标题印为「How to Break MD5 and Other Hash Functions」，作者印为「Xiaoyun Wang and Hongbo Yu」；摘要又印出「In this paper we present a new powerful attack」「on MD5 which allows us to ﬁnd collisions eﬃciently.」。因此该条目把王小云定位为这项 MD5 碰撞攻击的作者之一，不把 MD5 的设计归给她，也不把 2004 年首次公开的碰撞事件并进本行。
statement.en: **Person**: Xiaoyun Wang.It is registered under hashes.

statement.zh: 方法上的关键由论文自己印出：「The attack is a diﬀerential attack」，但「instead uses modular integer subtraction as the measure」；作者把这种差分称为「modular diﬀerential」，并印出「An application of this attack」「to MD4 can ﬁnd a collision in less than a fraction of a second.」。因此该条目只说这项攻击使用模差分、并可用于 MD4 等函数，不把方法扩写成对所有哈希函数的通用结论。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in hashes, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 论文给出的用途背景是签名与完整性，而不是某一家机构的部署：「The security of digital signatures depends on the cryptographic strength of the」「underlying hash functions.」。同一段还印出哈希函数用于「data integrity, group signature, e-cash」等协议；因此该条目只说碰撞攻击触及这些依赖哈希强度的用途，不声称王小云攻击了某个具体系统。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 边界与代价由论文印出：作者用该攻击「to ﬁnd collisions of MD5 in about 15 minutes up to an hour computation」；在 IBM P690 上「The application of this attack on IBM P690 takes about」「an hour to ﬁnd M0 and M0」，最快「where in the fastest cases it takes only 15 minutes.」。因此该条目所称的破限定为 MD5 碰撞可在分钟到小时级找到，不称原像或所有哈希函数同时被破。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh:
可断代的坐标由论文页印出：「EUROCRYPT 2005, LNCS 3494, pp.19–35, 2005.」，作者「Xiaoyun Wang and Hongbo Yu」署名「Shandong University, Jinan 250100, China」。论文同时把 MD5 的背景印为「MD5 is a hash function designed by Ron Rivest as a strengthened version of」「MD4 [17].」。因此该条目把王小云的这项成果断到 2005 年，不据此写她的生年、国籍或任职变动。**可核角色与证据链**
